# FAQ-014 Engineering FAQ #14

Revision: Rev A

Q1: What lubricant do we use for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L4-HT02)?
A1: The lubricant part number for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L4-HT02) is CFW-LUB-426. Reference lubricant master list and ordering per ECN-2026-033.

Q2: What is the main ram bolt torque for Hot Forge hydraulic forging press #1 (EQ-P3-L1-HP01)?
A2: The main ram bolt torque for Hot Forge hydraulic forging press #1 (EQ-P3-L1-HP01) is 1425 N·m. Apply during assembly and after major rebuilds; see machine bolting procedure in SB-1016.

Q3: What lubricant do we use for Machining CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P3-L3-CN02)?
A3: The lubricant part number for Machining CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P3-L3-CN02) is CFW-LUB-611. Use replacement and inventory procedures in ECN-2026-033.

Q4: What is the austenitizing oven setpoint for Machining heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L3-HT02)?
A4: The austenitizing setpoint for Machining heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L3-HT02) is 845 °C. Follow the control recipe and verification steps in MM-P2-L3-HT02.

Q5: What is the shot media replenishment frequency for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P2-L1-SB03)?
A5: The shot media top-up interval for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P2-L1-SB03) is 33 hours. Log top-ups per the maintenance checklist in SB-1016.

Related documents: ECN-2026-033, MM-P2-L3-HT02, SB-1016.
